(17 April 2016) | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2014–15 Saudi First Division|2014–15]] | nextseason = [[2016–17 Saudi First Division|2016–17]] | updated = }} '''2015–16 Saudi First Division League''' was the 39th season of the [[Saudi First Division League]] since its establishment in 1976. The season started on 21 August 2015 and concluded on 23 April 2016. On 23 April 2016, [[Al-Mujazzal Club|Al-Mujazzal]] won the league title and earned promotion to [[2016–17 Saudi Pro League|2016–17 Pro League]] along with [[Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]], while [[Al-Batin F.C.|Al-Batin]] qualified to the [[2015–16 Saudi Professional League#Relegation play-offs|promotion play-offs]]. [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]], [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]] and [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] were relegated to the 2016–17 [[Saudi Second Division]].{{cite web|script-title=ar:المجزل والاتفاق إلى جميل وهبوط الرياض والنهضة|trans-title=Al-Mojzel and Al-Ettifaq to Pro League, Al-Riyadh and Al-Nahda were relegated|url=http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14344|language=Arabic|work=thesaff.com.sa|publisher=Saudi Arabian Football Federation|date=23 April 2016|accessdate=24 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160505164813/http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14344|archive-date=5 May 2016|url-status=dead}} On 21 July 2016, the [[Saudi Arabian Football Federation|SAFF]] announced the relegation of Al-Mujazzal to the Saudi Second Division due to [[Match fixing in association football|match fixing]].{{cite web|url=http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14469|script-title=ar:الانضباط تقرر تهبيط المجزل للدرجة الثانية|language=Arabic|work=thesaff.com.sa|publisher=Saudi Arabian Football Federation|date=21 July 2016|accessdate=10 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160819212121/http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14469|archive-date=19 August 2016|url-status=dead}} On 3 August 2016, they announced that Al-Ettifaq were crowned champions and Al-Batin would be promoted to the 2016–17 Professional League instead of Al-Mujazzal, and they also announced that Al-Mujazzal would be relegated instead of Al-Nahda.{{cite web|url=http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14496|script-title=ar:بيان: صعود الباطن لدوري جميل وبقاء النهضة بالأولى|language=Arabic|work=thesaff.com.sa|publisher=Saudi Arabian Football Federation|date=3 August 2016|accessdate=10 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160819210314/http://www.thesaff.com.sa/NewsDetails.aspx?NewsID=14496|archive-date=19 August 2016|url-status=dead}}{{cite web |title=رسمياً .. رفض استئناف نادي المجزل وتثبيت هبوطه لدوري الثانية |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/492538}} ==Teams== A total of 16 teams are contesting the league, including 11 sides from the [[2014–15 Saudi First Division|2014–15 season]], two relegated from the [[2014–15 Saudi Pro League]] and three promoted from the [[2014–15 Saudi Second Division]]. [[Al-Shoulla F.C.|Al-Shoulla]] and [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] join as the two relegated sides.{{cite web |title=رسميا.. الشعلة والعروبة إلى دوري ركاء |url=https://www.alriyadh.com/1047074}} [[Damac F.C.|Damac]] were promoted as champions, while [[Al-Nojoom FC|Al-Nojoom]] were promoted as Group B winners. [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] secured the final berth by winning the playoffs.{{cite web |title="ضمك" بطل الدرجة الثانيه و "أحد" يخطف الصعود من "الكوكب" |url=https://www.hasanews.com/6270675.html }}{{Dead link|date=September 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division since the 2014–15 season. === To the First Division === '''Promoted from the [[2014–15 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Damac F.C.|Damac]] * [[Al-Nojoom FC|Al-Nojoom]] * [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] '''Relegated from the [[2014–15 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al-Shoulla F.C.|Al-Shoulla]] * [[Al-Orobah F.C.|Al-Orobah]] === From the First Division === '''Relegated to the [[2015–16 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al Safa FC|Al-Safa]] * [[Abha (football club)|Abha]] * [[Hetten FC|Hetten]] '''Promoted to the [[2015–16 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] * [[Al-Wehda Club (Mecca)|Al-Wehda]] ==Stadia and locations==
